claim: A shared file that every verification stamp depends on invalidates all stamps when edited, and a full selftest takes hours, so prefer additive modules and targeted checks.

evidence.text: Editing nexclash.py would mark all 80 games for re-verification; selftest over all games re-verifies about 60 in an emulator and takes hours.
Part only: verification is keyed to hashes of everything the build reads, so shared files mean rebuilding all dependents; the doc does not give the 80 games or the hours-long full selftest.
evidence.quote: A verification is evidence about exact inputs, not about a game
